name: Universal hardening (Windows)
description: Hardens Windows 10/11 and Windows Server images from the README of the image: accounts, password and lockout policy, security options, RDP, firewall, Defender, updates, services, shares, IIS, software and prohibited files. Run with -AuditOnly first.

name: Universal hardening (Linux)
description: Hardens Debian, Ubuntu and Mint images from the README of the image: accounts, sudo, PAM password and lockout policy, SSH, UFW, sysctl, services, packages, updates, display manager, permissions and prohibited files. Run with --audit first.

name: LEADS finder (Windows)
description: Run after hardening when points are still missing. Ranks the most likely unscored checks on Windows images with the reason and the fix, makes a few safe repairs and writes a report to C:\HardeningLogs.

name: LEADS finder (Linux)
description: Run after hardening when points are still missing. Ranks the most likely unscored checks on Linux images with the reason and the fix, makes a few safe repairs and writes a report to /var/log/hardening.
